description: Detects unsafe rendering or execution of LLM output that enables XSS, command injection, or second-order injection. Use when writing code that renders LLM output to a UI, executes LLM-generated code or shell commands, or passes LLM responses to downstream APIs or databases. Also invoke when displaying markdown or HTML from an LLM response.
